primary.title: Ramayana effect? Prime Focus Q2 results: Revenue rises to ₹1,410.17 crore; PAT climbs to ₹91.04 crore from ₹5.8 crore
primary.summary: Prime Focus reported Q2 FY27 net profit of ₹58.27 crore, up from ₹4.06 crore a year earlier, as revenue rose 35.2% to ₹1,410.17 crore on strong visual-effects demand. The company swung from a ₹45.78 crore loss in the June quarter and disclosed Income Tax Department searches in October.
